library(dplyr)
library(sf)

# 1x synthetic scale-up: copy each precinct centroid 1 time
origins = centroids %>% slice(rep(1:n(), times = 1))

# pre-filter: which polls sit within 500 m of each origin?
within = st_is_within_distance(origins, polls, dist = 500)
# the true nearest poll, found without any radius
nearest = st_nearest_feature(origins, polls)
gap_m = st_distance(origins, polls[nearest, ], by_element = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()

tibble(n = nrow(origins), m = nrow(polls),
       candidates = sum(lengths(within)),
       found = sum(lengths(within) > 0),
       missed = sum(lengths(within) == 0),
       mean_nearest_m = mean(gap_m)) %>%
  mutate(
    comparisons = n * m,                 # brute force: every origin x every poll
    distance_calcs = n * m,
    plan = "Seq Scan on polls")
code.sql:
-- brute force: measure every origin against every poll
SELECT o.id, MIN(ST_Distance(o.geom, p.geom)) AS nearest_m
FROM origins o CROSS JOIN polls p
GROUP BY o.id;

code.sql:
-- no spatial index on polls.geom

SELECT o.id, near.id AS poll_id, near.dist_m
FROM origins o
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT p.id, ST_Distance(o.geom, p.geom) AS dist_m
  FROM polls p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(o.geom, p.geom, 500)
  ORDER BY dist_m
  LIMIT 1
) near;
